mentions.name: dub-anything
mentions.description: This tool generates subtitles and dubs for any video in the actors' own voices, using AI voice synthesis to make untranslated media watchable.
mentions.problem: Many movies have never been translated to English, leaving a world of previously inaccessible media unavailable to viewers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Generate subtitles and dubs for any video, in the actors' own voices

https://github.com/swax/dub-anything

I use it to watch movies that have never been translated to English.
